# Elanster Technologies

> AI-enabled development and product engineering company in Chennai, India, a unit of ED Creative Group. Eight years of engineering; AI products shipped to production in 4 to 12 weeks; two meetings a week (Monday planning, Friday sprint review).

## FAQ
- **How fast can you deliver an AI MVP?** Most AI MVPs ship in 4 to 12 weeks from kickoff to production — not a prototype, but a deployed product on real infrastructure. Timelines depend on scope; we'll give you an honest estimate on the strategy call.
- **What AI-enabled development services do you offer?** Full-stack AI products end to end: AI-enabled development, AI integration into existing products, autonomous agents and workflow automation, RAG pipelines, and AI consulting — all backed by eight years of web, mobile, and cloud engineering.
- **Which industries do you work with?** We've delivered across e-commerce, healthcare, faith-based organizations, human resources, education, professional services, and retail. Strong engineering fundamentals travel well between domains.
- **What makes you different from other AI development agencies?** We're not an AI shop that learned engineering last year — we're an eight-year product engineering company that builds AI properly. Architecture first, humans in the loop, production-ready from day one, and accountable long after launch.
- **How do your engagements work?** We start with a strategy call to understand your goals, constraints, and timeline. From there we map the right model — a fixed-scope build, an embedded product team, or ongoing partnership — with two meetings a week and full visibility throughout.
- **Do you work with enterprise clients?** Yes. Enterprise delivery is our default standard — security protocols, code review discipline, and compliance-aware architecture apply to every project, whatever its size.
